purpose: Define a small canonical synthetic fixture pack for deterministic astrology regression coverage before product-level fixture plumbing lands.

backend: Use as the source of truth for future deterministic report-generation, chart-serialization, and context-building fixtures.
Bind fixture ids to pytest parametrization and benchmark packs instead of copying inline payloads.
frontend: Use fixture ids to seed Playwright/report-read demo data and stable screenshots.
Prefer scenario labels and invariant classes from this manifest for E2E naming and evidence packets.

global_rules.canonical_time_policy: All local timestamps are explicit. Unknown-time fixture intentionally records local input date plus a canonical midday fallback expectation.
global_rules.house_system_policy: Manifest records the intended primary house-system coverage goal per fixture; runtime may compare Placidus vs Whole Sign where stated.
global_rules.privacy_policy: Names, coordinates, and notes are synthetic and repo-safe.
global_rules.phase_1_constraint: No product behavior is changed by this manifest; it is a fixture contract for later backend/frontend wiring.

fixtures.purpose: Stable exact-time control fixture for end-to-end natal report generation, serialization, and read-surface regressions.
guards: chart serialization normalization remains stable for a normal exact-time natal path
report context preserves explicit birth_time_known=true semantics
read/report surfaces keep deterministic section availability and basic factual shape
benchmark reruns retain a clean representative exact-time natal control

fixtures.purpose: High-latitude edge fixture that canonically exercises Whole Sign fallback/selection and protects house-system-sensitive regressions.
guards: high-latitude workflows expose the expected Whole Sign-safe behavior or warning contour
timezone and location evidence remain visible in input/read surfaces for edge geographies
backend/frontend paths do not silently regress into broken or misleading house calculations
existing high-latitude verification remains anchored to a canonical synthetic case

fixtures.purpose: Canonical unknown-birth-time fixture for cosmogram-style flows, protecting midday fallback and reduced-certainty UI/report contracts.
guards: unknown-time payloads preserve birth_time_known=false through chart and report context building
cosmogram/midday fallback remains deterministic and inspectable
frontend/backend surfaces can distinguish exact-time vs unknown-time confidence semantics
future fixtures do not accidentally encode guessed birth time as known data
